topic: Overwithholding for a big tax refund vs adjusting withholding and putting the difference to work monthly (Merritt vs Matilda)

scenes.narration: A big refund means you overpaid all year. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in a bright clinic holding a clipboard with a giant refund check stamped OVERPAID, comic burst banner reads YOUR OWN MONEY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Merritt and Matilda earn the same sixty thousand dollar salary.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split clinic panel of man merritt and woman matilda each holding a pay stub reading SIXTY THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both get a thirty six hundred dollar refund every April.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two identical refund checks reading THIRTY SIX HUNDRED, a calendar page reads APRIL, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Merritt loves it. He calls it his forced savings plan.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man merritt grinning and kissing a refund check, a thought bubble reads FORCED SAVINGS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Meanwhile he carries a card balance at twenty two percent all year.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man merritt with a credit card statement reading TWENTY TWO PERCENT INTEREST, a heavy weight on his shoulder, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The refund arrives and he spends it in three weekends.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man merritt with shopping bags, a new TV, and a restaurant bill, the refund check torn into pieces, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Matilda updates her W4 and adds three hundred dollars to each paycheck.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman matilda filling out a form labeled W4, a pay stub shows an extra line reading PLUS THREE HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: That extra pays off her card by June and kills the interest.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a credit card statement reading ZERO BALANCE with a calendar page reading JUNE, a bandage on the interest line, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: After that, the three hundred goes straight into her Roth IRA.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, an automatic transfer arrow from a paycheck into a jar labeled ROTH IRA, THREE HUNDRED MONTHLY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her refund next April is near zero, exactly as planned.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman matilda holding a tiny refund check reading TWELVE DOLLARS with a satisfied smile, a note reads AS PLANNED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Twenty years later, those monthly deposits grow to one hundred seventy thousand dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a clinic growth chart climbing to ONE HUNDRED SEVENTY THOUSAND, woman matilda flexing beside it, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Fix your withholding and pay yourself monthly. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in a bright clinic holding a clipboard reading FIX YOUR WITHHOLDING, a healthy savings chart behind her, kids comic book illustration
